title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 08/2015
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLIIS (S1) and Maxell MX-Metal (S2). Set up FOB, recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Audience-sourced recording with good sound captures a high‑energy set featuring a tribal Rhythm Devils jam, a Phil‑heavy Not Fade Away, and a bouncy Sugaree.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised for its clear and enjoyable sound, earning a solid four‑star rating. Reviewers love the show’s vibe, especially the “tribal” Rhythm Devils segment, the bass‑forward Not Fade Away, and the JGB‑style bounce of Sugaree. Overall it’s considered a beloved performance that finally sees an audience release.

ai_rating.rationale: Single positive review (4 ★) highlights strong musical performance and decent audio quality; limited data leads to low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the sound is “nice” and good enough for a four‑star rating; no major flaws mentioned, indicating clear enough audience capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow with a highlighted tribal Rhythm Devils jam and strong, bass‑driven second‑half momentum.

band_member_comments.Phil: Not Fade Away described as heavy on the Phil side, indicating standout bass work.
band_member_comments.Drums: Rhythm Devils portion called “tribal,” suggesting a strong percussive performance.
